title: The First 48
description:
S07 E03 — Frenzy; Hard Truth
Miami police investigate the murder of two men gunned down in the middle of a residential street; Cincinnati police search for a suspect in a shooting that left one man dead and another wounded.

title: The First 48
description:
S20 E06 — Buried Secrets
In Mobile, Ala., a 68-year-old woman goes missing after checking into a casino where she had lost millions.

title: The First 48
description:

title: The First 48
description:

When a young man is found executed in the street and a second victim is shot nearby, detectives scramble to track down the dangerous gunman before he kills again.

title: The First 48
description:
S20 E03 — A Bad Run-In; Inferno

description:

description:

description:

title: Homicide Squad New Orleans
description:
S01 E10 — The Rookie
Aided by the know-how of veteran officers in the department and his own investigative skills, Rookie Detective Donnie Willyard tracks down a suspect who allegedly shot a man in the front entrance of his home nearly 10 times.

title: The First 48 Presents: Homicide Squad Atlanta
description:
S01 E02 — The Dark Staircase
The Fallen Angel investigation takes homicide detectives back to the scene of the crime; as they sweep the city park for evidence, they discover a surveillance camera with vital footage of the victim's car at the time of her murder.

title: Homicide Squad New Orleans
description:
S02 E01 — Digital Grudge
An online dispute turns into a physical fight that ends with a mother losing her life; as Det. Fyfe unravels names of possible suspects, he zeroes in on a gang that has been terrorizing the city.

title: Homicide Squad New Orleans
description:
S02 E05 — Search on the Bayou
Detective Matt Riffle investigates the murder of a New Orleans native, who was shot and killed after a brief altercation; Det. Tanisha Smith investigates the homicide of a young mother and the abduction of her daughter.

title: Homicide Squad New Orleans
description:
S02 E04 — Bourbon Street Drive By
Detective Nick Davis investigates a homicide in the French Quarter after an innocent bystander is shot and killed; with minimal evidence at the crime scene, Det. Davis tracks a car seen fleeing Bourbon Street moments after the shooting.

title: Homicide Squad New Orleans
description:
S02 E02 — Beware Thy Neighbor
Detective Maurice Stewart investigates the murder of a woman, who was allegedly gunned down by her neighbor after an argument over cats and dogs.

title: Homicide Squad New Orleans
description:
S02 E07 — Fight and Flight
A night out turns into a tragedy, as Detective Matt Riffle works to uncover the circumstances that led to a father of six being fatally shot outside a nightclub.

title: Court Cam
description:
200th Episode Special Part 1
A special counting down some of the wildest and most outrageous courtroom moments to ever appear in the first 200 episodes of Court Cam.

title: Court Cam
description:
S02 E10 — Episode 10
A defendant takes a desperate stab at a prosecutor with a metal shank; a foul-mouthed woman goes off on her attorney; a state trooper delivers a powerful testimony.

title: Court Cam
description:
S02 E05 — Episode 5
A courthouse escape goes wrong; a woman collapses after getting convicted of conspiring to kill her husband; an out-of-control defendant bites a court officer.
